class.name: FellowVehicleEffects3D
class.brief_description: A FellowVehicle3D's skid marks, tyre smoke and sounds: its engine, its tyres and the road (FellowEngine).
class.description: A child of a [FellowVehicle3D]. While the game runs: where a tyre slides — faster than [member slip_min] over the ground and past its grip (its combined slip beyond [member slide_slip]: a tyre held at its peak by the traction control or the anti-lock brakes leaves nothing) — it lays a skid mark (a ribbon [member mark_width] wide, a segment every [member mark_step], darker as it slides harder up to [member slip_full]) in one mesh in the world, the oldest of [member max_mark_segments] segments reused; and it smokes (a GPU particle system at each wheel, [member smoke_amount] particles over [member smoke_lifetime], emitting as much as the tyre slides). Its sound is synthesised as it drives, in an [AudioStreamPlayer3D] at [member engine_offset] (heard through [FellowAcoustics3D] like any other): the engine's firing frequency (its revolutions times [member cylinders] over two) and its harmonics, a burst of noise at each firing, brighter and louder with the throttle and the revolutions, the crankshaft's rumble below; the tyres' squeal (noise through a resonant band-pass from 800 to 1 500 Hz) as they slide; the road's rumble with the speed squared. See decision 0187 in FellowEngine's [code]docs/decisions[/code].

method.name: get_audio_player
method.description: Returns the [AudioStreamPlayer3D] the vehicle's sound plays in (made when the node is ready; [code]null[/code] before).

method.name: get_global_stats
method.description: Returns every vehicle's totals since the start or [method reset_global_stats]: [code]frames[/code], [code]usec[/code] (the marks and smoke on the CPU), [code]segments[/code] (marks laid), [code]synth_usec[/code] and [code]samples[/code] (the sound synthesised).

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns this vehicle's [code]mark_segments[/code] (in its mesh), [code]segments_laid[/code], [code]mark_low[/code] and [code]mark_high[/code] (the laid marks' heights), [code]marks_aabb[/code], each wheel's sliding [code]intensity[/code] (0-1), the wheels [code]smoking[/code], [code]dusting[/code] and [code]on_loose_ground[/code], the [code]visible_segments[/code] (not faded out), the last frame's [code]usec[/code] and [code]synth_usec[/code], and the [code]sound_rpm[/code] the engine's sound is at.

members.member: The engine's cylinders: its firing frequency is the revolutions a second times half of them (a four-stroke engine).

Dust at each wheel rolling on loose ground (milestone 88): GPU particles thrown up and drifting, more with the speed (from [member dust_min_speed] to [member dust_full_speed]) and with the tyre's sliding; there the tyre's smoke is not made.
The dust particles a wheel emits over [member dust_lifetime] at full intensity.
The dust's colour, unless the ground's collider has the metadata [code]fellow_dust_color[/code] (a [Color]): then that one (one colour for the vehicle's dust at a time).
The speed over loose ground at which the dust is fullest, in m/s.
A dust particle's lifetime, in seconds.
The speed over loose ground from which a rolling tyre raises dust, in m/s.
Where the sound plays, in the vehicle's space.
The engine's level.
The group of the colliders that are loose ground (dirt, gravel, sand, snow): on them tyres raise dust and leave ruts as they roll.
How long the marks last, in seconds: past half of it a segment fades out, gone at its end (its colour written again four times a second). 0: they stay until their segments are reused.
The marks' opacity where a tyre slides hardest.
The length of a mark's segments (metres).
The marks' width (the tyres', metres).
The segments of marks the vehicle keeps: the oldest are reused.
The road's rumble's level.
The opacity of the ruts a tyre leaves rolling on loose ground (sliding, the skid marks' opacity if more).
If [code]true[/code], sliding tyres leave marks on the ground.
The combined slip (the slip ratio and the slip angle's tangent together) past which a tyre slides: its marks, smoke and squeal grow from it to 0.2 more.
The tyre's speed over the ground (m/s) at which its marks, smoke and squeal are full.
The tyre's speed over the ground (m/s) under which it leaves no marks or smoke and does not squeal.
If [code]true[/code], sliding tyres smoke.
The particles of each wheel's smoke.
The smoke's colour (its alpha the particles' when new; they fade out).
Seconds a particle of smoke lives.
If [code]true[/code], the vehicle sounds (its engine, tyres and the road).
Farther than this from the listener (the viewport's [AudioListener3D] or camera) the vehicle is silent: its player stopped, nothing synthesised.
The sound's [member AudioStreamPlayer3D.unit_size].
The tyres' squeal's level.
